Commentary.Commentary: The total is one which is quite chasable. It was mentioned at the toss that the wicket is generally a 170-180 one, so you'd think Bangladesh have fallen some 20-25 runs short. This is one the Lankans will fancy. Would be interesting to see though as a couple of early wickets could change things. Join us in a short while for the run chase.

A brilliant comeback from Sri Lanka towards the latter half of the innings. They were taken for runs by the Bangladeshi openers and looking at that, it seemed the visitors would runs away with the game. But, wickets at regular intervals, most importantly that of Shakib Al Hasan and a brilliant hat-trick from Lasith Malinga in the 19th over, restricted Bangladesh to under 180 which is impressive considering how they were hit for runs early on.

OUT! Run out to end proceedings. Kulasekara angles in a full ball on off, Saifuddin digs it out straight back and comes running out in search of an impossible run. Nuwan calmly picks up the ball and scores a direct hit at the striker's end to find Mohammad short of the crease. BANGLADESH END ON 176/9!
FOUR! Length ball around off, Saifuddin swings his bat, middles his shot well and it beats the diving fielder in the deep at mid-wicket for a boundary. Welcome runs.
The batsman has lofted that over mid off. One run added to the total.
Good yorker, Mahmudullah keeps it out towards covers and the non-striker wants a run. He is sent back and in case of a direct hit, Saifuddin would have been in trouble.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Bangs in a short ball around off, Saifuddin swings and misses.
Nuwan Kulasekara will bowl the final over of the innings.
A low full toss on off, Saifuddin pushes it through covers for one. 4 runs and three wickets off it, exceptional Malinga!
Mohammad Saifuddin to take the bat next for Bangladesh.

OUT! HAT-TRICK FOR LASITH MALINGA! The crowd has gone bonkers, what a bowler, what a genius bowler! Slower full ball around leg, straightening a bit, Hasan fails to pick the variation, misses to flick it out after getting across the stumps and is rapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up immediately. Malinga lets out a huge roar in celebration. This is his fourth hat-trick in international cricket, first in T20Is.
Mehedi Hasan comes out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Two in two for Malinga and it's a sorry end with the bat for Mortaza in his final T20I match. Slinga once again deceives the batsman with a slower delivery, it's full and on middle, Mashrafe backs away to play it late down to third man but misses. The stumps take a beating yet again and Malinga is on fire. On a hat-trick now...
Mashrafe Mortaza will be the new man in. This is his last T20I match. Can he make something out of these last few deliveries?

OUT! Third bowled dismissal in this innings. Malinga outfoxes the batsman with his clever change in pace and serves it full in the line of the stumps, Rahim is a week early into his attempted slog, misses the ball completely and finds his off stump disturbed. The umpire checks for a no ball upstairs but it is fine. The quick cameo by Rahim is over quickly.
Walks down the track and Malinga slips one on the pads, Rahim has smartly nudged it to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Fullish and angling in, swung over square leg for a single.

SIX! It's a brilliant sight to see a short guy packing a punch. Perera lets out another low full toss around off, Rahim bends on his one knee and muscles it over mid-wicket for a maximum. 14 off the over!
FOUR! A low full toss around off, Rahim shuffles across the stumps and paddles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Full toss on middle, Rahim kneels and slogs it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Mahmudullah has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks into the middle next.

OUT! Sound of timber! Perera has been very accurate by his standards. Sends across a very full ball in the line of the stumps, Mosaddek moves back to make room, tries to dig it out but misses. The stumps are shattered and it's a great start to the over.
Thisara Perera returns.
Full toss on the pads, helped over square leg for one. 13 off the over!
FOUR! Boom! No half measures there. Malinga misses his yorker mark this time, Hossain receives the full toss with glee and whips it past the long on fielder for a boundary.

SIX! Wow, it has gone all the way. It looked like a mishit though. A slower full ball around leg, Mosaddek hops back to make room and heaves it across the line. It flies off the toe end of the bat and sails over long on for a biggie. Seems it travelled with the wind.

Excellent thinking from the bowler. Follows the batsman down the leg side with a full toss, Mosaddek fails to make any use of it as he swings his bat early. Takes a blow on his pads and it rests near the surface.
Keeps it very full and around off, Mahmudullah drives it through extra cover for a single.
A very full delivery around leg, it's tickled through square leg for a single.
And, Mahmudullah will bat next.
Lasith Malinga to have a go with the ball again.

OUT! Shakib is bowled! A big wicket at this stage! Kulasekara angles in a full length ball from around the wickets, it's in the line of the sticks as Shakib shuffles across to play a cheeky paddle shot. Fails to connect and it disturbs the leg pole. A handy knock by him but Bangladesh needed him to stay till the end.
Angles in a length ball around off, Mosaddek backs away and pushes it straight towards covers for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Another fantastic delivery by Nuwan, follows the batsman down the leg side who has given the charge as well, it's very full, nearly becomes a yorker and Shakib does well to dig it out.
Spears in a very full ball around leg, following the batsman down, Shakib digs it out and gets it away off the inside edge onto the pads.
Angles in a length ball on off, Mosaddek gets back to make room and strokes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Nuwan Kulasekara is back into the attack.
Keeps it very full and around middle, not allowing any room, Hossain works it through mid-wicket for a run.
A low full toss again, around off, Shakib eases his drive down to long off for one.
Perera switches to around the wicket and bowls a full toss on the pads, Mosaddek tickles it through mid-wicket for one.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
A low full toss on off, Shakib forces it through the line but finds covers.
A widish yorker outside off, Shakib flashes and misses.
In the blockhole, Shakib squeezes it to the off side and retains strike.
Too full in length and off, Shakib eases it down to long off and returns for the second run. The throw from the deep was quite weak.
Full toss on middle, Shakib once again chips it over the bowler's head for a brace.
Safest part of the ground. Full and on middle, Shakib lofts it down the ground for a couple of runs.
On the pads, tucked through mid-wicket for one.
Mosaddek Hossain is the next batsman in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Sanjaya spears in a very full ball around off, Rahman gets across the stumps to flick on the leg side but misses. It nips away a bit, beats his willow and destroys his stumps. Sanjaya is pumped up. A big wicket as Sabbir can get dangerous later in the innings.
Vikum Sanjaya is back on.
Slower and fuller on off, pushed back to the bowler to end a tidy over.
Very full and on off, firmly struck down to long on for a run.

Superbly done. Perera runs in from around the wicket and angles across a full ball, it's around off and Rahman tries to play the paddle scoop. Fails to connect as it goes past his bat. They appeal for a catch, a muted one but nothing from the umpire.
A touch short and angling down, Sabbir swings his bat and gets a top edge over short fine leg. It's chased down just before the rope and they take a couple of runs.
Very full and on off, Shakib digs it out through mid off and rotates the strike.
Fuller and on middle, Shakib drives it straight back, just misses the stumps at the non-striker's end and it speeds to the deep. They take a couple of runs.
Thisara Perera into the attack.
Fuller on off, forced to long off for one.
Fullish around off, skidding away, Shakib tries to slog across the line but is beaten.

FOUR! Great footwork on this occasion. Shakib gives the charge and Kulasekara seeing that goes wide outside off. The batsman still manages to middle his lofted shot and clears the infield with ease for a boundary at long off.
FOUR! Nicely done with fine leg up inside the ring. A length ball around off, Shakib shuffles across the stumps a bit and scoops it over the fielder. It nearly went all the way.
Slower cutter outside off, Rahman squeezes it out on the off side and takes a single.
Fullish and on the pads, flicked in front of square leg and took a single.
Nuwan Kulasekara is back into the attack.
Rahman has played it towards mid-wicket. Two runs added to the total.
Slower full ball around leg, Shakib picks the variation early and goes hard at it. Middles his pull but it has gone straight to the fielder in the deep square leg region. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, turned behind square leg for a run.
Pitches it full and wide outside off, Rahman throws his bat hard at it but gets a bottom edge behind towards the keeper.
Slips one down the leg side, Rahman tries flicking but misses.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Full in length around middle, Shakib mistimes his shot back to the bowler.
Vikum Sanjaya is back on to bowl.

DROPPED AGAIN! Munaweera the culprit this time. Sri Lanka are being sluggish in the field and this can cost them. Tossed up ball on middle, Shakib swings his bat across the line and gets a top edge. It balloons in the air, Munaweera charges in from deep mid-wicket, puts in a forward dive but fails to catch it. They take a single. 12 runs off the over.
FOUR! What a shot! Strong bottom hand on this occasion. A flatter delivery, Shakib gets deep inside the crease and packs a punch through mid-wicket for a boundary.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Full in length on middle, Shakib gets down and slogs it in front of square leg. Sanjaya in the deep moves across to his right, for some reason he was quite inside the boundary line, tries to grab the catch with a dive to his right but it deflects off his fingers and goes on one bounce to the fence.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and wide outside off, angling away, Shakib rocks back and slashes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Walks a bit down the track and pushes a length ball through cover-point for a single.
Goes back and turns it on the leg side for a single.

SIX! That's smoked! A very, very clean hit from Sabbir Rahman. He stays brave, skips out, gets to the pitch and connects right off the middle of the bat. Sends it sailing over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Loopy and full down the leg side, Shakib Al Hasan misses his attempted sweep shot as the ball goes off his pads.

HUGE LBW SHOUT! But it's turned down. Tossed up around off, Sabbir Rahman looks to play the reverse sweep but is hit on the front pad. The umpire doesn't respond to the appeal and signals a leg bye as the batsmen run across. Strange, there was some glove visible on it.
Going across on a length, Shakib punches it through the covers for a single.
Darted on the stumps, Shakib drills it to long on for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan in next.

OUT! KAYES IS RUN OUT! Some exceptional work in the field has undone him here. Sabbir flicks it straight to the short fine leg fielder and takes off. Dangerous stuff but there's no turning back now. Upul Tharanga the man to fire in the throw to the keeper who whips the bails off in a flash. It goes upstairs and replays show Kayes is just short of the crease, even the dive didn't work. Sri Lanka back in this game now.
Run out appeal is referred upstairs. Looks touch and go...
Stays right behind the line of this fuller length delivery and blocks with a straight bat.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flat, quite short and on the stumps, pulled away through mid-wicket by Imrul Kayes for a brace.
A slight hesitation in the running but the batsmen complete it in the end. Sabbir taps this one in front of covers and a single is taken.
Seekkuge Prasanna will bowl now.
Full around off, Sabbir Rahman drives it to long off for a run to end the over.
A bit too straight, on middle and leg, it's clipped through the gap in the leg side for a run.
Back of a length outside off, punched square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Sabbir Rahman is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Gunaratne gets the breakthrough! Lovely bowling. He bowls another loopy cutter, full on off, Sarkar is probably early into the shot and just chips it back to Asela. He pouches with ease and with that, breaks the fiery opening stand of 71. In the previous match, Soumya Sarkar's dismissal saw a collapse in the Bangladesh batting line-up. Are we going to see a repeat of that?
Serves this on a length, it's on the pads so Imrul Kayes turns it through square leg for one.
Loopy cutter on middle, quite full in length, comfortably wristed to square leg for a double.
Asela Gunaratne is into the attack now.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second. Bangladesh are 68/0 at the end of the Powerplay. A great start for the visitors.
Good change in variation. On a back of a length on middle, the lack of pace takes Sarkar by surprise. Beats the bat and goes off the thigh pad.

FOUR! Almost a catch.... Soumya Sarkar just survives. Fuller on middle and off, Sarkar barely lofts it over a leaping Upul Tharanga at mid off. Did all he could but the ball just went over him and away to the rope.

FOUR! That's a boundary but Malinga is quite unfortunate there. He serves another accurate yorker on off, goes off the outside edge of Soumya Sarkar's bat and flies past the diving keeper. Races away to the third man fence in a flash.
Bowls another yorker on middle and off, Imrul can only squeeze it out in front of cover-point. Sets off for the run and completes it easily.
Wide! Gets his radar wrong this time, hurls it down the leg side and it's a clear wide.
Yorker right on the money. The perfect man to release pressure and keep the runs in check. Beautiful stuff. He instantly fires it on middle which forces Kayes to defend.
Lasith Malinga is back into the attack.

SIX! BANG! That's outta here! What a hit. On the stumps, a bit short, Sarkar from within his crease muscles the pull over the mid-wicket boundary for half a dozen. Nothing anybody could do about that.
Wide! Slips it down the leg side, Soumya looks to glance but misses.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Completely in control of that shot and dispatched it well. Good batting, this. Outside off on a length, Kayes backs away a bit and slaps it over covers for a boundary.
A full-blooded blow from Imrul Kayes but he's unfortunate to find the fielder. He charges down to this full ball and smacks it straight to the mid on fielder.
Flatter delivery on middle and off, on a shorter length, Sarkar skips out and tucks it to square leg for one.
Sliding in with the angle, it's flicked away on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over. Big one for Bangladesh. 18 have come in it. Sarkar charges down, goes inside out and sends it across the cover fence for a boundary.

SIX! This time he connects and connects well. Got a lot behind that one. Full and in the slot on off, Sarkar stands his ground and hammers it right over the bowler's head. No need to move for that as the ball clears the fence with ease.
Play and a miss! Full outside off, Soumya Sarkar with an expansive drive which he fails to connect.
Angling in from around off, on a good length, Kayes walks across a step and tucks it square on the leg side for a quick run.
SIX! Terrific hit! Fuller around off, Kayes skies this really, really high. It's soaring towards the wide long off boundary and just about clears the rope. A biggie to Kayes' name.

In the air... But safe! Quite comfortably in fact. Full outside off, Sarkar doesn't middle it as he attempts to get it over the covers. Clears it eventually but it falls just over the chasing fielders. A single taken.
Vikum Sanjaya is into the attack.
Walks down the track to this but Soumya Sarkar cannot connect with the bat. He tries flicking it away but fails to do so. A leg bye is taken however as the ball lobs off his pads on the off side.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
On the shorter side, around off, kept out off the back foot.
Short and flat and it's coming into the body, Imrul pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Excellent shot! Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result. It's full and outside off, Kayes plants his front foot forward, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the covers for a boundary.
Flat, short and wide outside off, Kayes backs away and cuts it to the cover-point fielder.
Wide! Sprays this down the leg side, continues from around the wicket, wide called.
Advances down the track to a full ball and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Dilshan Munaweera is introduced into the attack.
FOUR! Another cracking shot from the bat of Kayes. A full toss on middle, once again Kayes does well to make room and crunches his drive through covers for a boundary. Fantastic over for Bangladesh!
FOUR! That's a quality shot! Nothing wrong with the delivery, it's full and around middle, Imrul hops back to make space and drives it crisply through covers for a glorious boundary.
A length ball around the leg stump line, Kayes tries working on the leg side but misses and is hit high on the front thigh pad.

Serves a length ball on middle and off, Sarkar gives the charge and swings his bat across the line. It comes off the inner half of the at and speeds to deep mid-wicket. A single taken as a fielder is planted in the deep.
Straighter in line on this occasion, Kayes plays it down, in front of mid on and pinches a single.
Good length ball around off, Kayes stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point.
Nuwan Kulasekara to bowl from the other end.
Fired in full on middle and off, angling in, Sarkar stays right behind the line and defends with a straight blade.

FOUR! First boundary of the evening! From around the wicket this time, it's full and quite wide outside off, Sarkar stretches his arms out and gets enough bat on it. Clears the infield over point and sends it across the rope for a boundary.
First runs off the day for Bangladesh. It's driven towards mid off and a quick single is taken.
Oooofff.... Close call! Another full delivery from Malinga, speared just outside off, some visible inswing once more and Kayes gets an inside edge onto his pads as he looks to drive.
Spears it full once again, outside off, Kayes leans ahead and drives it hard straight to the cover fielder.

Right on the money straightaway! No surprise from Malinga, as expected. He fires it full and gets it to swing back in on off, on a fuller length, Imrul Kayes works it off the inside half towards mid-wicket.

The National Anthems are done and dusted with and now, the players and umpires have made their way out in the middle. Sri Lanka with a team huddle, Imrul Kayes and Soumya Sarkar take their guard. It will be Lasith Malinga to kick things off with the ball. A slip in place...

Upul Tharanga says he would have batted first too but he doesn't mind as it's a good wicket. Adds that as a team they have been playing well. States there is no change in the team. Ends by up hoping that they have a good game.

Mashrafe Mortaza says they would like to bat again. Mentions if you look at it, when you bat second you have the freedom to bat and the players perform well. Adds it looks a similar wicket, a 170-180 wicket. Says he feels proud and happy, wants his family to feel proud of him and thanks the people supporting him throughout his career.
TOSS - BANGLADESH WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST!

Pitch Report - All about boundaries today. No threat of rain, so should have a full game. Nice covering of grass, so the ball will come on to the bat nicely, which the spectators will like. Not many cracks, hard surface. Has been a long tour and there could be a firecracker of a finish today, reckons Russel Arnold.

Hello and a warm welcome for the final T20I game between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. The hosts won the 2-match series opener in emphatic fashion, a charge which was led by Kusal Perera. Bangladesh will do everything they possibly can as this will be Mashrafe Mortaza's final match in this format. After everything he's done for the team, the Tigers will want give him a roaring send off. Should be an exciting contest.
